description: Synthetic benchmark tasks — no real private data

reasoning_tasks.text: A car travels 150 km in 3 hours. Calculate average speed.
A train covers 480 km in 4 hours. What is its speed?
A runner completes 10 km in 50 minutes. Calculate speed in km per minute.
A bicycle travels 90 km in 3 hours. What is the average speed?
A ship sails 500 km in 25 hours. What is its speed?

atlas_tasks.text: A car travels 150 km in 3 hours. Calculate average speed.
Revenue is 500 units at price 20 each. Calculate total revenue.
An algorithm processes N items in O(N) time. How many operations for N=100?
A beam supports a load of 500 kg over 2 metres. Calculate force per metre.
A population of 200 organisms doubles every 3 hours. What is the count after 6 hours?
An investment of 1000 grows at 5 percent per year. What is the value after 1 year?
A solution contains 50 grams of solute in 250 ml of solvent. Calculate concentration.
